summary: The Karjan reservoir at its most scenic, hill-ringed water off Mandan village, 16 km from Rajpipla, with cheap boat rides and roasted-corn stalls.
description:
Mandan Lake View is what happens when a working reservoir grows a beauty spot: on the Karjan's western banks near Mandan village, the water spreads between low green hills and small islands, 'tapus', and the view has quietly become the Rajpipla belt's favourite picnic, photo-shoot and camping backdrop. Monsoon and the months after are the show, when the reservoir brims and everything around it runs green.

The experience is endearingly informal: a rough 1–1.5 km approach road off the main route, parking managed by villagers, local boats doing rounds for ₹150–200 a head, and corn roasting on the banks. Pre-wedding shoots stake out the ridgelines; overlanders camp the flats. There is no ticket, no gate and no infrastructure beyond what Mandan village improvises, which is precisely the charm.

It shares its water with the Karjan dam viewpoint a few kilometres north, and stacks with Juna Ghanta falls for the belt's full monsoon loop.
highlights: Boat rounds for ₹150–200 and corn on the banks
The Rajpipla belt's favourite photo-shoot backdrop

modes.road: 16 km from Rajpipla toward Mandan village; the final 1–1.5 km is a rough approach track
modes.rail: Ekta Nagar station (~40 km); Ankleshwar Jn (~75 km)

access.last_mile: Short walk from the informal parking to the banks and viewpoints
access.road_condition: Good until the last 1–1.5 km, which is broken and slow

parking.notes: Informal, managed by villagers; small fee likely

fees.note: ₹150–200 per person reported for local boat rounds

visit.notes: Open banks, no gate; busiest on monsoon weekends and holidays.

seasonality.notes: Brimming and green July–November; shrinks and browns by late summer but stays scenic.

experience.photography_notes: Golden hour over the tapus from the ridge above the parking; drones are popular here but check current rules near the dam.

amenities.food: Corn and snack stalls in season; meals in Rajpipla
amenities.guides: Not needed; boatmen narrate the tapus

warnings: Reservoir depths drop off fast, no swimming, and life jackets on boats are worth insisting on
The approach track punishes low cars; go slow
Campers: levels rise with dam operations, pitch well above the waterline

tips: Evenings beat middays, light, breeze and corn stalls all improve
Stack with Karjan dam viewpoint and Juna Ghanta falls for the full loop
Weekdays give you the tapus almost alone

faqs.q: Is Mandan Lake different from the Karjan reservoir?
faqs.a: Same water, different vantage: Mandan village's banks and islands are the scenic southern face of the reservoir the Karjan dam impounds a few kilometres north.
